summary: Phase 2 backend re-verification: outbound multi-key menu routing (Telnyx + Twilio single + bulk), Per-Number Voice IVR template wizard, and 3 regressions (Twilio single billing, bulk billing, call reconciler). All 6 pytest tests PASSED. Node syntax OK for js/_index.js, js/voice-service.js, js/bulk-call-service.js. Code review of wizard + menu-builder handlers and opt-in guards confirms design matches spec.

Wizard handlers cpIvrTplVoice (line 30301) and cpIvrTplSpeed (line 30351) correctly branch: default voice -> cpIvrTplApply directly; premium voice -> cpIvrTplSpeed -> generate audio -> cpIvrTplApply. voiceKey/voiceName/ttsSpeed/greetingAudioUrl are persisted onto info.cpIvrTplPending.
Outbound menu builder states ivrObMenuHome/KeyAction/ForwardInput/MessageInput/SubGreetInput/SubHome all present with Back + remove handling; Done writes ivrObData.menu / bulkData.menu.
Opt-in guards confirmed: Twilio single-ivr-gather (line 44648), bulk-call-service (line 169), voice-service (line 4809) all gate on session.menu / campaign.menu and exclude otp_collect / report_only.
Preset save/load persists preset.menu (line 23703 draft init) and is used in the ivrObPresetName state.
BulkNudge scheduler present (js/_index.js line ~3767) and production-only (dev sandbox skips actual nudging).
